environment.runtime: headless Node; no browser or physical-device qualification

informationBudget.observation: full current engine state and past events
informationBudget.scheduler: all current scheduler and movement phases

candidateIdentity.informationBudget: Full current game state, including RNG, frightened-sequence index, scheduler and movement phases. No recorded future controls.
candidateIdentity.dependencyPolicy: Local static JavaScript imports only; no external or dynamic imports, require, fetch, or recorded-evidence modules. This is an integrity boundary, not a hostile-code sandbox.

computation.controllerSimulationAccounting: Existing frozen policy does not expose synchronous simulation-step counts. Finished and failed turns report elapsed time; interrupted turns retain an elapsed lower bound and unknown steps.
computation.scope: Elapsed measurements include attempted, failed and cancelled work. Concurrent durations are not CPU time. Unknown simulation counts are null, never zero.

qualification: Fresh game with natural transitions; the referee continues independently of all candidate computation. Late or mismatched actions are rejected; held direction continues.

replay.qualification: Reproduces the recorded legal controls against the fixed referee. Does not rerun the policy or independently establish real-time deadlines.

policyReplay.qualification: Recomputes controller decisions and requests from fresh private memory and reconstructed engine observations at the recorded worker-delivery boundaries. Nested planner replies are replayed evidence; their computations and real-time deadlines are not rerun.
